title: upgrade_attempt telemetry payload
description: The `payload` of POST /api/v2/products/{product}/telemetry with measurement_type="upgrade_attempt", sent once per terminal upgrade outcome by the v2 installer via `loguploaderservice.exe upgrade-report`. Reuses the existing telemetry endpoint (open JSON payload) — NO backend change.

outcome.description: rollback_failed is the only true Sev-1

cause.description: short human-readable reason for a non-ok outcome

agent_version.description: the v2 agent version doing the reporting

health_ms.description: how long the health check took

config_notes.description: v1 config keys that could not be translated (FR-014b)
